## `UpdateDomainAccessRestrictionsByAppID`

**PUT** `/v2/manage/restrictions/domain-access`

Update Domain Access Restrictions

Updates the domain access restrictions for the Tenant.

### Example

```c#

        Console.WriteLine(response);
```
